asteroid.explanation:
What is reassuring

The market read is complete, with deep liquidity and trading spread over 222 trades in 24 hours. No liquidity removal was observed, and the trading rules cannot change trade amounts. Of the supply, 79.59% circulates outside pools. The largest holder has 4.27% of it, across 2968 holder addresses.

What deserves attention

The creator sold this token over its 96-day life and sold in 8 of 10 other checked launches, within 11 days of each. The creator also received 6.91% of supply as trading fees from the hook in 52 transfers. Six addresses received 7.71% of supply from the creator, and one of them passed its share on to 105 addresses. SEAL found 11 launches, and graduation is read only on pons, so their outcomes are unknown.

Where the signals diverge

The current holder picture looks dispersed, yet the launch window tells another story. 17 early buyers bought 17.94% of supply within 60 seconds and now hold 0.00%. Four of the addresses that bought early also received tokens from the creator, and one of them (0x7d5d…) is the wallet that first funded the creator. A transfer links addresses without proving who controls them. None of the top 8 holders received tokens from the creator, so the linked addresses are no longer among the visible holders. The report is partial: only 3 holder pages were read, so smaller holders are not covered.

mut8.explanation:
What is reassuring

No sale by the creator and no liquidity removal were observed on this token over its whole life, which is one day. Trading is active, with buys and sells in similar numbers, and the creator's wallet was funded by an ordinary wallet with no other creators on record. The trading rules (hook) have no standard upgrade slot set, though other upgrade patterns were not checked.

What deserves attention

Only 80.04% of the supply circulates outside pools and the lock contract, and three contracts hold about 27% each of that. The top 10 hold 87.34%. The creator's own launch transaction delivered 71.43% of the supply to 3 other addresses, all contracts, and they still hold 64.54%. That links them to the creator, though it does not show who controls them. 189 early buyers bought 97.16% of the supply in the first minute, a sum of purchases, not a holding.

Where the signals diverge

The creator's record looks quiet: no sales and no withdrawals. Yet the supply sits in a few contracts tied to the creator's launch transaction. The transfer read also found 0 holders that received tokens from the creator outside markets, so the link comes only from that launch transaction, which delivered into pools. The hook can alter trade amounts, and what it does with that power cannot be read. Distinct traders were not collected, so 671 trades cannot show breadth. The report is partial: other launches by this creator cannot be listed, graduation is undetermined, and holder pages are incomplete.

aml.explanation:
What is reassuring

None of the 6 holder addresses read received tokens from the creator, and no liquidity removal was observed in the first 11 days. The trading rules (hook) have no standard upgrade slot, though only that one pattern was checked and the token's own contract was not.

What deserves attention

It also took tokens out of the liquidity position as collected fees without removing liquidity, and the hook paid it 0.02% of supply in 3 transfers. Only 0.15% of supply circulates outside pools and trading-rules contracts, and one wallet holds 86.13% of that sliver. The hook can alter any trade amount, and what it does with that power is not readable here.

Where the signals diverge

The market looks large, with about 8.1 million USD of liquidity and 7.3 million USD of 24-hour volume. Yet almost nothing circulates, and the 11 early buyers, who bought 11.23% of supply in the first minute, hold 0.00% today. No swap has occurred for at least an hour, despite that daily volume. The distinct traders were not collected, so whether the volume comes from many people cannot be settled. The creator's other Doppler launches cannot be listed and graduation is undetermined, so the report is partial.

kel.explanation:
What is reassuring

No liquidity removal was observed on this pool, and the trading rules contract has no standard upgrade slot set, though other upgrade patterns were not checked. The creator's first funder is an ordinary wallet with no other creators on record.

What deserves attention

The creator sold this token and took tokens out of the liquidity position without withdrawing liquidity. The trading rules paid it 0.12% of supply in fees in 1 transfer. Only 0.20% of supply circulates outside pools, so one wallet holding all of that is a very thin base. The first funder of the creator's wallet also bought in the launch window and sold again about 70 seconds later. The 3 first-minute buyers bought 5.37% of supply and hold 0.00% today. The trading rules can alter any trade amount, and what they do with that power is not readable.

Where the signals diverge

The market looks alive, with about 12,000 USD traded in 24 hours and 18,650 USD of liquidity, yet no trade has occurred for at least 6 hours. Volume is also split 34 buys to 66 sells, and distinct traders were not collected. That makes it unclear whether many people trade or a few addresses cycle. The creator record is partial: other Doppler launches cannot be listed, and graduation is undetermined. Reassuring liquidity facts therefore sit beside creator sales and fee extraction that the available history cannot put in context.
